visual_action: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (AOC) stands at a podium and delivers a speech at what appears to be a political convention, with a blue, star-patterned background. She gestures emphatically as she speaks.

cast.name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
cast.evidence: She is the sole speaker in the video, and is identified by face and on-screen text ('AOC').

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: AOC repeatedly says 'Kamala is for you' and calls to 'elect Kamala Harris to the presidency'.

cast.name: Democratic National Convention
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads 'AOC at the DNC'.

on_screen_text.text: AOC at the DNC: Kamala is for you.
are a working parent trying to afford rent and childcare,
who had to go back to work
because your retirement didn't stretch far enough,
when we knock on our neighbor's door,
we will send a loud message
that the people of this nation will not go back.
We choose a new path and open the door to a new day.
One that is for the people and by the people.

spoken_summary: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez delivers a speech endorsing Kamala Harris. She argues that Harris is 'for' working parents, seniors who had to return to work, and immigrant families. She urges the audience to organize their communities and elect Kamala Harris to the presidency on November 5th, framing it as a choice for a 'new path' and a government 'for the people and by the people'.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's speech, with audible applause and cheering from the crowd in response to her statements. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with no cuts or camera movement, presented in a talking-head style.
cultural_references: The line 'one that is for the people and by the people' is a direct reference to Abraham Lincoln's Gettysburg Address.
central_claim: Kamala Harris is the candidate who represents and will fight for the interests of everyday working-class Americans, seniors, and immigrants.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers to support and vote for Kamala Harris by portraying her as a champion for various demographics, and to energize Democratic voters.
